title: ProcReverser: Multi-Agent Black-Box Microarchitectural Reverse Engineering for Processor Vulnerability Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.20827v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When processor implementation details are unavailable, black-box microarchitectural reverse engineering helps security researchers identify hardware conditions related to security vulnerabilities. However, this process requires substantial manual effort to design experiments, develop test programs, and analyze results for each processor. We present ProcReverser, a multi-agent system that automates this process. ProcReverser uses execution feedback to improve experimental plans and test programs and identifies microarchitectural properties from measurements. We develop a comprehensive suite of property identification tasks focused on hardware mechanisms relevant to Spectre-class attacks, covering speculative execution, branch prediction, memory dependence, and cache behavior. We evaluate ProcReverser on the XuanTie C910, the gem5 RISC-V O3 CPU model, and the SiFive P550. ProcReverser achieves Pass@1 and Pass@5 scores of 81.3% and 93.8%,

translated_title: ProcReverser：面向处理器漏洞分析的多智能体黑盒微体系结构逆向工程
translated_abstract: 当处理器的实现细节不可获得时，黑盒微体系结构逆向工程可以帮助安全研究人员识别与安全漏洞相关的硬件条件。然而，这一过程需要对每个处理器进行大量的人工工作，包括设计实验、开发测试程序和分析结果。我们提出了ProcReverser，一个能够自动化这一过程的多智能体系统。ProcReverser利用执行反馈来改进实验计划和测试程序，并通过测量结果识别微体系结构特性。我们开发了一套全面的特性识别任务套件，聚焦于与Spectre类攻击相关的硬件机制，涵盖投机执行、分支预测、内存依赖和缓存行为。我们在玄铁C910、gem5 RISC-V O3 CPU模型和SiFive P550上对ProcReverser进行了评估，其Pass@1和Pass@5分数分别达到81.3%和93.8%。
tldr: ProcReverser是一个多智能体系统，通过利用执行反馈自动迭代实验设计和测试程序，实现了黑盒微体系结构逆向工程的自动化，能够高效识别与Spectre类攻击相关的处理器硬件安全特性。
en_tdlr: ProcReverser is a multi-agent system that automates black-box microarchitectural reverse engineering by leveraging execution feedback to iteratively refine experiments and test programs, efficiently identifying hardware properties related to Spectre-class attacks.
